messages:
mina (PM): quick check-in 1: Q2 candidates: Model Pinning, Adaptive Batching, Predictive Prefetch. sketched RICE below, need flags (contracts/legal/infra).

omar (Sales): heads-up Acme Health will not renew unless pinning + audit exists. high priority from their legal.

mina (PM): rough RICE: Pinning R~3500, Batching R~1700, Prefetch R~1200 (very rough).

devin (Eng): Pinning is smallest effort (routing + metadata). Batching helps latency/cost more broadly. Prefetch is infra-heavy.

sam (Infra): Prefetch needs infra quota and extra ops; can't start this quarter without reprioritizing core infra work.

rita (Design): Pinning UI MVP is small: org toggle + audit view. estimate 2 design days.

prio-bot: poll opened: "Which order for Q2? 1=Pinning->Batching->Prefetch, 2=Batching->Prefetch->Pinning, 3=Parallel"

devin (Eng): +1 for 1 because of Acme. set launch criteria: per-org routing enforced in canary + audit export + no p95 regression >10ms.

mina (PM): plan: lock Option 1 unless objections by EOD. I'll write PRD and assign owners.

omar (Sales): I'll get Acme date and legal acceptance criteria.

sam (Infra): noted. will prepare audit storage cost estimate.

prio-bot: poll closed 4 votes -> Option 1 wins.

mina (PM): locking sequence: Pinning first. batching spike stays in backlog. Prefetch deferred to Q3. thanks.
